reviews.review:
This game will get overlooked nowadays because it's 2D instead of the 3D sequel and it's pixel art but I still think this is a very good roguelite.

back when I couldn't buy games, I had a 'copy' of this game and I put an unholy amount of time in it and enjoyed it a lot. Now well, i got the four pack to make up for that since I wanted to support the devs and I wanted to get my friends into it. 
[strike] I failed in the latter. [/strike] 

The variety of items and survivors combined with the various artefacts helps keep the game very replayable and fun. The gameplay is mostly a journey from the weak survivor you have to the god of destruction you can make at the end.

Chris Christodoulou did the music as he would later do for Deadbolt and Risk of Rain 2 and this person is incapable of making bad music. I would argue that a major part of ROR, ROR 2 and Deadbolt is the music. The atmosphere it lends was critical to me.

Issue: the final level is bugged. It lags like hell after looping a lot in endgame even though it shouldn't really.

This game is amazing.
It used to have "Overwhelmingly Positive" reviews before the second game came out.

I have played this game for over 20 hours despite what my logged time says (at the time of writing it says I have played less than an hour).
(I know how much time I have played from the stats screen in game, I have also played many more hours with friends)

A bunch of people are coming from the second game and giving this one bad reviews for not being like the sequel.
In my opinion, these people DO NOT know what they are talking about and you should not listen to them. 
Give this game a chance.

The second game is great, but it doesn't make this one bad just by existing.
Honestly it greatly upsets me to see such an amazing game, one of my favorite games of all time, be disrespected like this.

Most people who have left a bad review barely even played it at all.
This is a hard game, you can't expect to "experience" it in a few hours or less.
Many bad reviews have played less than 30 minutes....
Many others are complaining about something that can be fixed via ingame settings....
This game is hugely influential in it's genre, it deserves a far better review ratio imho.

To those giving this game such terrible reviews, for what I see as no reason, please pick it up again and reconsider.
You will not regret it, if you actually give it a fair chance.

If you enjoy difficult rogue likes designed to be tamed via skill rather than grinding with the potential to have ridiculously fun OP runs with some luck and proper decision making this is a great game to play.

HIGHLY recommended if you enjoy games such as The Binding of Isaac, FTL, Nuclear Throne, or rogue-likes/lites in general.

A solid game with a fun gameplay loop and cool mechanics. If you don't like games that become absurdly hard then this is not the game for you. After 10 hours of play I have only beaten the final boss twice on the easiest difficulty. It is one of those games where you say one more run and end up 2 hours later with enough goat hoves to beat the flash in a race.
